definitions.explanation: The way parts are arranged to form a whole.

examples.japanese: {文章|ぶんしょう}の{構成|こうせい}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think about the structure of the text.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}は10{名|めい}で{構成|こうせい}される。
examples.english: The committee is composed of 10 members.

notes:
{構成|こうせい} refers to composition and structure.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜で{構成|こうせい}される (to be composed of...)
- {構成|こうせい}{要素|ようそ} (component, element)
- {構成|こうせい}{員|いん} (member, constituent)
